subject: Private VPC architecture review - scheduling technical deep dive
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Janelle Reed <janelle.reed@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC architecture review - next steps

Hi Sam / Janelle,

Thanks again for taking the discovery call today — great to learn more about Acme's regulatory requirements and why a private/VPC deployment is important for you. Quick recap of what we covered:

- Primary goals: PII data residency, audit logs retention (7 years), and network isolation for ML inference.
- Major constraints: strict outbound access controls, customer-managed KMS, and support for on-prem connector for batch model updates.
- Next step requested: Technical deep dive with our solutions + security engineering to review private VPC architecture and network requirements.

I've attached our Private VPC security checklist and would like to schedule a 60-min architecture review. Proposed times (Pacific):

1) Thu Oct 22, 10:00 - 11:00 AM PT
2) Thu Oct 22, 02:00 - 03:00 PM PT
3) Fri Oct 23, 09:00 - 10:00 AM PT

Can you confirm which of these works, or share 2-3 times that do?

I'll loop in Marissa (Solutions) and Nikhil (Security) on the invite once we lock a slot. Also attaching the checklist and the initial network diagram you shared during discovery (kept in this thread for reference).

Thanks,

Aditya Rao
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182

Attachment: Redwood_Private_VPC_Security_Checklist.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: initial-network-diagram.png (image/png)

From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme-corp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Janelle Reed <janelle.reed@acme-corp.com>, platform-ops@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC architecture review - next steps

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the recap and the checklist. Both Janelle and our platform team reviewed and we're aligned to proceed.

The Thu Oct 22 10:00 AM PT slot works for us. A couple quick items to flag so your team can prep:

- We need to validate support for our on-prem batch pipeline to push model updates (SFTP/FTPS).
- Our security team will want to review how audit logs are exported and stored (S3 w/ server-side encryption + KMS).
- We'll share our network ACLs and a more detailed VPC peering proposal ahead of the call.

Please send a calendar invite with the dial-in/Zoom link. Also loop in the person who owns customer KMS integrations on your side.

Best,
Sam Turner
Sr. Engineering Manager, Platform
Acme Corp
sam.turner@acme-corp.com

--

- 25 min: Detailed private VPC architecture walkthrough (Marissa + Nikhil)
- 15 min: Network/DNS/peering questions and actions
- 10 min: Next steps / mutual action items /timeline

Marissa will lead the architecture walkthrough and Nikhil will cover KMS/audit logging requirements. Sam, could you please upload your VPC ACLs and the more detailed peering proposal to this Drive folder before the meeting: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d5E6f ? Also adding the KMS owner from our side: Nikhil (cc'd) — Nikhil, please be ready to discuss supported KMS flows (Bring Your Own Key, HSM integration notes).
